# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Rachel Lynde  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a fat woman who waddles when she walks.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 c38 P31](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0031)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a capable, industrious woman who manages both her own affairs and those of her neighbors. She prides herself on speaking her mind directly, often without fear or favor, which can lead to outspoken and blunt remarks. She possesses a keen curiosity about local goings-on and will not rest until she ferrets out information. Despite her pessimism and tendency to gossip, she is a kindly, Christian woman at heart who never shirks her duties or hesitates to admit when she is wrong.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c1 P30](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0030), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde resides with her meek husband, Thomas, in Lynde's Hollow, a location along the main road that allows her to watch all who enter or leave Avonlea. Upon spotting Matthew Cuthbert driving out in his best clothes, she visits Green Gables out of curiosity and learns that the Cuthberts plan to adopt an orphan boy. Soon after, when Marilla and Matthew decide to keep Anne Shirley instead, Mrs. Rachel visits Green Gables to inspect the child. Her blunt criticisms of Anne's freckles and red hair trigger an explosive outburst of temper from Anne, leading to a feud that resolves when Anne delivers a dramatically thorough apology. Over time, Mrs. Rachel grows fond of Anne, praising her progress and helping Matthew secure a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for her Christmas gift. She remains a prominent community figure, active in church work, politics, and local affairs, and eventually brings word to Green Gables that Anne has been offered the Avonlea school.
